name: Draft edits
title: Draft edits: every change you made to an email Rouh drafted before you pressed Send, what Rouh wrote and what you sent

events.edits_learned: You changed a draft Rouh wrote and sent it, and Rouh noted how

permissions: when you press Send on an email Rouh drafted on a card and you changed it first, keeps the draft as Rouh wrote it, the email as it went and each place they differ; nothing is sent, and nothing is put back into what Rouh is told
touches.remove: Turn the switch draft_edits off on its row in Evolution, Mutations: nothing more is recorded and Anatomy, Behaviour has no Draft edits. To remove it for good revert night 11's commit and mutation request 2's (rouh/draft_edits.py, its call in composing.py, the first on a compose block, rouh/web/draftedits.py and its address in urls.py, draftedits.js and draftedits.css, the draft-edits section in index.html and settingsPages in app/runs.js, migration 0165 and this manifest), and drop the table draft_edits.
